title: Ramy Saboungui — 'The one book I've been recommending day after day is Incorruptible'
summary: A creative strategist frames the two books as a sequence: the first taught him how to get an idea to walk and run, and left out how to keep it safe once it was operational. He credits the trinity of entities as the shield, and notes the book hands readers a community and artifacts on the way out.
blockquote:
The one book I've been recommending day after day is Incorruptible by Eric Ries 

Eric once outlined a lean canvas to take your newborn idea, test and validate, get it to walk, and maybe even run. That book helped me quite a bit. What that book did not outline was how to keep your now operational ideas safe.
